title: AI Content Specialist
description:
- Full time 35 hours per week, Monday-Friday
- Fully onsite, with secure, free daily parking.
- Excellent benefits/perks.
- 25 days holiday plus public holidays + up to 3 days Long Service entitlement
- Birthday day off
- Enhanced Workplace Pension
- Group Life Insurance
- Employee Assistance Programme free access to wellbeing and support tools
- GP24 free unlimited 24/7 access to a GP
- Training and development opportunities

My client is in urgent need of a professional with experience in forward-thinking AI-assisted Content Writing to join their SEO team. If you're passionate about improving models and excited by the future of AI, this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

We re looking for detail-oriented professionals to support a variety of content and AI-related evaluation tasks. This is a strategic role that combines creativity, technical skill, and editorial precision to produce high-performing content using generative AI tools. Reporting to the Head of Content and SEO, you will help shape and scale our clients content strategy with hands-on exposure to SEO and market expansion initiatives.

This role presents a timely opportunity to bring in the next generation of content talent.

We are seeking someone who understands the fundamentals of great storytelling and thrives in a digital landscape powered by AI. You will help modernise how we deliver content by creating smarter, faster, and more engaging copy that performs across web, CRM, social, campaigns, and more. Your ability to merge narrative craft with automation, efficiency, and strategic thinking will play a vital role in strengthening our brand and delivering meaningful results across the business.

What you will be doing:

You will be responsible for user engagement, and acting as a subject matter expert in content and user journey. You will be tasked with driving new and innovative content aimed at increasing revenues earned.

About you:
- Strong experience in digital content production
- Strong experience of SEO
- Commercially experienced in AI platforms.
- Ideally some experience in managing production of social content.

The role will involve producing, writing and optimising content for the end-to-end customer experience to ensure the needs of my clients customers remain at the forefront of all journeys. This may include written, long form and short form video, social media and podcasts.

title: Communications and Engagement Manager
description:
Communications and Engagement Manager Future Projects

Location: Norwich, with occasional Norfolk-wide travel
Hours: 37 hours per week (subject to the Four Day Week scheme following 6 months in post)
Salary: £35,000 to £38,000 pa (depending on experience)
Leave: 25 days per annum plus Bank Holidays
Application Deadline: Monday 14th December 2026

Interviews: Week commencing Monday 21st December 2026
Reports to: Head of Funding, Partnerships and Impact

About the Role

Future Projects is a Norwich charity, founded in 2000, helping people in difficult situations build the skills, confidence and resilience to take control and transform their lives. We provide practical support across food and essentials, advice and guidance, health and wellbeing, employment, education and community connection.

As Communications and Engagement Manager, you will lead how Future Projects is seen, heard and understood. In this strategic role across the whole charity, you will strengthen our brand, voice and visibility, help Future Radio grow its profile, and make sure communities help shape our services and the story of our impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the rollout of our brand, verbal identity and key messages, turning them into guidance, templates and training for staff.
- Develop and deliver a communications and marketing plan linked to the charity s strategy.
- Oversee website content, social media, newsletters, press, printed materials and campaigns.
- Work with the Future Radio team to promote the station and use radio, podcasts and digital content to support community voice.
- Develop community engagement and feedback approaches so people help shape our services and communications.
- Turn outcomes, data and case studies into impact stories that support fundraising and partnerships, with strict GDPR-compliant consent.

About You
- Strong experience in communications, marketing, media, engagement or brand.
- Excellent writing and editing skills for different audiences and channels.
- Experience developing communications plans, campaigns, content and brand assets.
- Strong understanding of digital communications, websites, social media and accessibility.
- Sound judgement around consent, GDPR, safeguarding and sensitive stories.
- Confident supporting and training colleagues, and building relationships with leaders, partners, funders and media.
- Desirable: charity or social impact sector experience, and an understanding of community media, radio, podcasting or video.

How to Apply
- Apply through this advert to receive an application form, along with the full job description.
- Complete the form in full, using the person specification and key deliverables to structure your answers. CVs are not accepted without a completed application form.

Additional Information
- Office and service-site working, with some flexibility around campaigns, events and launches.
- May line manage communications staff if such roles are created.
- Induction and training provided, including Health and Safety and Safeguarding.
- Appointment subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, two references and an appropriate DBS check.
- Future Projects is an equal opportunities, Living Wage and Disability Confident employer.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We are looking for a digital marketing specialist to join a small & ambitious Marketing Team.

This is a role for someone who loves testing, learning and turning data into real commercial results. You'll take ownership of SEO, paid social, digital PR and website development. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines creativity with data-led thinking and understands how great content drives great results.

What you ll do
- Analyse engagement, rankings, enquiries, conversion rates and cost per lead to understand which activity delivers the strongest commercial return
- Produce clear monthly reports that explain performance, identify opportunities and recommend actions to improve the quality and volume of sales enquiries.
- Track performance using GA4, Google Search Console, SEMrush and social reporting tools, turning insight into clear actions.
- Help set meaningful KPI S for content, social media, SEO and digital campaigns, aligned with wider business objectives
- Plan, create and manage content across website, Instagram, Facebook and other digital channels.
- Support SEO, digital PR, link building and paid social campaigns
- Work with colleagues, agencies, photographers and videographers to produce strong creative assets

What were looking for:

We are looking for someone who combines creativity with data-analytics. You should enjoy developing engaging content but also want to understand how that content performs and how it contributes to traffic, enquiries and ultimately sales.

You will be naturally curious about customer behaviour, comfortable working with data and prepared to challenge or change marketing activity when the results suggest a different approach is needed.
- 3+ years in digital marketing, ideally across B2 C markets
- Proven PPC experience on Meta and Google Ads
- Solid SEO, GEO and AEO knowledge with a record of improving rankings
- Strong analytical skills and confidence interpreting performance data
- Desirable: HubSpot experience, a Bachelor s degree in Marketing or similar, CRO/UX awareness, photo and video skills,
- Experience creating commercial website and campaign content and managing business social accounts.
- An organised, proactive approach, strong attention to detail and a creative eye.

Rewards & benefits being offered:
- £33,000 £38,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working: three days in the office and two from home
- 28 days annual leave increasing with length of service
- Health Shield healthcare cash plan
- Death in service insurance
- Contributory pension scheme
- Excellent staff facilities with recreation area
- Opportunity to use the company holiday home
- On site parking

If you re a Digital Marketing Specialist looking for a new challenge and want to be part of a team that has a real impact on business performance, apply today.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Paid Performance Marketing Manager
- Norwich
- Hybrid 1-day from home
- Competitive Salary

Brief

We're working with an ambitious and growing business looking to appoint a Paid Performance Marketing Manager to take ownership of their paid acquisition strategy across both Paid Search and Paid Social channels.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced digital marketer who thrives on data, optimisation and driving measurable results. You'll be responsible for planning, executing and optimising campaigns that generate high-quality leads, increase brand visibility and maximise return on advertising spend.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise Paid Search campaigns across Google Ads and Bing.
- Develop and execute Paid Social campaigns across platforms including Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok.
- Monitor campaign performance and analyse key metrics including ROI, ROAS, CPA and conversion rates.
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting and competitor analysis.
- Manage advertising budgets and ensure spend is allocated effectively.
- Deliver regular performance reports and provide strategic recommendations.
- Work closely with internal teams to align campaigns with wider marketing and commercial objectives.
- Test and implement new channels, audiences, creatives and optimisation strategies.
- Drive continuous improvements through A/B testing and data-led decision-making.

Requirements
- Proven experience managing Paid Search and Paid Social campaigns.
- Strong understanding of Google Ads, Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager.
- Experience working with significant advertising budgets.
- Highly analytical with strong reporting and data interpretation skills.
- Commercially focused with a track record of delivering measurable results.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable
- Experience with LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads or TikTok Ads.
- Knowledge of SEO and broader digital marketing channels.
- Experience using marketing automation or CRM platforms.

Salary: Competitive

This role would suit a Performance Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing Manager, Paid Media Manager, PPC Manager or Growth Marketing professional looking to make a significant impact within a growing business.

title: SEO Executive
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and data-driven Digital Marketing Executive with a passion for SEO, content creation and digital growth. You will play a key role in increasing our visibility on Google, driving organic traffic, and generating high-quality enquiries for our sales team.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced SEO professional with strong technical expertise and a proven track record to join our award-winning organisation and make a measurable impact and shape our digital marketing strategy.

Key Responsibilities of the SEO Exeutive:
- Develop and implement SEO strategies to improve organic search performance.
- Conduct keyword research and identify latest content opportunities.
- Create and optimise website content, including landing pages, blogs, guides, and case studies.
- Monitor keyword rankings, website traffic and user behaviour.
- Manage and improve Google Search Console and Google Analytics performance.
- Optimise existing website content to improve search visibility and conversions.
- Support local SEO initiatives and Google Business Profile optimisation.
- Work closely with sales and design teams to identify customer insights and marketing opportunities.
- Produce regular reports demonstrating ROI and marketing performance.

About the SEO Specialist role:

You ll be commercially minded and understand that digital marketing is about generating quality leads, not just website visitors.
- Experience in SEO and digital marketing.
- Strong understanding of on-page and technical SEO.
- Experience with Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
- Excellent written communication and content creation skills.
- Ability to analyse data and make recommendations based on performance.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

Desirable:
- Experience using SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs or Moz.
- Knowledge of local SEO strategies.
- Experience in retail, construction or luxury consumer products

What Success Looks Like:
- Increased organic website traffic.
- Improved rankings for key commercial search terms.
- Expanded library of helpful, search-driven content.
- Improved visibility across target geographic locations.

In Reward for your expertise:
- £34,000 £40,000 salary, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working: three days in the office and two from home
- 28 days annual leave increasing with length of service
- Health Shield healthcare cash plan
- Death in service insurance
- Excellent staff facilities with full equipped kitchen area
- Opportunity to use the company holiday home
- A friendly, collaborative environment with a strong sense of ownership.

If you re ready to lead ambitious SEO work and play a key role in the success of a progressive business, apply today.
